description: The MET tower will be approximately 328 feet (100 m) tall above mean sea level.
context_quote: The overall height of the MET tower structure (mast & foundation) will be approximately 328 feet (~100 m) above the mean sea level.

description: Monthly operations and maintenance visits to the MET tower will occur.
context_quote: A planned operations and maintenance (O&M) visit out to the MET tower by the US Wind Baltimore based O&M contractor is proposed once a month for 2 days duration out of Ocean City MD.

description: Trenching activities are prohibited within 500 meters of the identified historic shipwreck.
geographic_scope: Area within 500 meters of historic shipwreck
context_quote: To avoid any potential for disturbance of man-made features, the areas in which small magnetic anomalies were detected will be avoided during bottom disturbing activities.

description: All vessels must maintain a speed of 10 knots or less in designated areas to avoid collisions with marine mammals.
geographic_scope: Designated areas around the MET tower
context_quote: All vessel operators must comply with vessel strike reduction measures for North Atlantic right whales implemented by NMFS.
